content_zh: 交互装置（旧电脑、旧智能程序、废旧家电、电子元器件）
该项目产出自2026“荡一圈”杭州当代艺术周期间的电子垃圾艺术驻地项目“886计划：边角料发射信号”。
让当代AI想象用千禧年代的电子废品构筑自己的身体，会得到一些绚烂的视觉效果图。但如果人类尝试与AI协作去实现这种想象，则要面对各种各样的现实工程问题。旧的计算系统和电子设计与新的智能系统和通信链路之间的失配导致项目预期不断滑落，但在粗陋地缝合各类硬件和软件的过程中，想象的挫败也会打开对计算系统与电子工业的技术史回溯。
项目的最终产出为由古董电子拼合而成的”伪智能体“：千禧年聊天机器人在旧笔记本电脑上借由早期版本的Python得以复生，通过简陋的通信电路控制小型废旧家电，在与观众的互动中展示自己失败的身体构造，并连带出机电设备、控制元件和通信工具的变迁历史，以及关于智能迭代的技术反思。
content_en: Interactive Installation (obsolete computers, outdated intelligent programme, discarded household appliances, electronic components)
The project emerges from the electronic waste atrist residency programme '886: Transmitting Signals from Scraps' at 2026 'Make a Swing' Hangzhou Contemporary Art Week.

When contemporary AI is prompted to imagine building its own body out of electronic scraps from the 2000s, it yields striking visualisations. Yet when human attempts to collaborate with AI in realising this vision, they would face a variety of practical engineering challenges. The mismatch between outdated computing systems and electronic designs on the one hand, and new intelligent systems and communication links on the other, leads to a continuous slippage away from project expectations. However, in the haphazard piecing together of disparate hardware and software, the frustrating mismatches between imagination and reality would also trigger a retrospective look at the technological histories of computing systems and the electronics industry.

The output of the project is a 'pseudo-agent' assembled from obsolete electronics: a Millennium chatbot, revived on an old laptop powered by an early version of Python, which controls small, discarded domestic appliances via rudimentary communication circuits. Through interactions with the audience, it reveals its flawed bodily structure, thereby evoking the historical evolution of electromechanical equipment, control components and communication tools, as well as prompting technical reflections on the iterative development of artificial intelligence.
